serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Yes, I have it.
Landlord: {{punch}}Give me that!
As he said that he forcibly took my suitcase with money.
You: Aren’t you gonna count?
Landlord: Hmph! Do you take me for an amateur? I can tell how much’s in it by weight.
You: Sure…
Landlord: I will send in the crew to install the door in a few days and remember! No refunds!
You: After you hide the money, could I get my suitcase back?
Landlord: No.
